title: Eastern Samar mulls desalination for island barangays amid El Niño

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — The provincial government of Eastern Samar is considering tapping its vast seawater sources through desalination to mitigate the impacts of the ongoing El Niño dry spell, particularly in off-grid island communities. Eastern Samar Governor Ralph Vincent Evardone announced that pilot testing for desalination machines will be conducted exclusively in island villages, funded in part by the P100 million disaster risk reduction and management grant the province received from the national government. “We have an abundance of seawater.
